.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm
    :tickets: 10888

    Fixed :class:`.OrderingList` assignment outside ORM instrumentation so
    slice assignment accepts any iterable, correctly grows or shrinks the
    list, and supports extended slices using normal Python list semantics.
    ORM collection instrumentation now also consumes iterable extended-slice
    values before validating their length.  Integer-like indexes are
    normalized through :func:`operator.index` before updating an item's
    ordering value.
